data.narrative:
Tritone Technologies is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Ofer Ben-Zur. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (ticker: 277810.KQ) operating in the same sector and stage.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—yield a median valuation of $1.8B with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. This peer set includes established Series B robotics companies with demonstrable traction and capital raises.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.5B to $2.0B, centered on $1.8B. The lower bound reflects potential discounting for execution risk or relative stage maturity within Series B; the upper bound reflects the top of the peer range. Key uncertainties include the company's specific revenue or unit economics relative to peers, which are not available in this analysis. Additionally, the single applicable valuation method limits triangulation robustness; incorporation of revenue multiples or DCF analysis would strengthen conviction. The composition of the broader peer universe—predominantly private (8 of 9)—suggests limited public market signals for direct calibration.
